details: The rewrite replaces an unused secondary result by an arbitrary value. Puddle Pattern.Valid requires elementwise refinement of every root result; MatchDecl.Models deliberately forgets use-count facts from inspectOperation. It cannot validate the exact upstream dead-result replacement without a liveness-aware semantic model (and the add/sub arbitrary replacement can have a different type).

VeIR lacks the matched Arith floating-point opcodes and their interpreter semantics (including exact APFloat formats, rounding modes, NaN/signed-zero behavior and fast-math). Existing RuntimeValue.float alone does not supply these semantics; the LLVM interpreter also leaves floating arithmetic unsupported. A Puddle Valid proof using failed interpretation would be vacuous, so none is claimed.
